what: Photos · cards lean forward (rotateX −15°), sitting 35px lower, at .94 scale and transparent, and when the top edge reaches 80% of the screen they unfold and stand over 2.5s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1). Scrolling back up leans them forward again (back: false means once only)

options.back: If “false”, it stands once and ends — original gallery row · default bows again when returning up (original lineup card)
options.--fx-perspective: Perspective, default 1500px — use 500px to tilt from up close like the original timeline photo

use: · Once only: data-fx-tilt-rise-in="back: false"
note: In the original, perspective is set on the parent (list) and the children tilt with rotateX. The part puts perspective() in front of each element’s transform so the parent on the user’s side is left untouched — the vanishing point is each element’s center rather than the list’s center, so the tilt of the end items is slightly less oblique.

from.where: index.html lineup card (.js-reveal, bows again when scrolling up) · gallery row photo (.js-reveal-gallery, once) · history photo · craftsman story card (top 70% within the horizontal flow — containerAnimation)
